interval_meta.name: density.interval
interval_meta.interpretation: Effective interval cardinality (n_eff − 1) from the raw pairwise kernel sum S: (sqrt(1 + 8 S) − 1) / 2. Exact unison doublings are excluded from vertical interval structure.
assumptions: Lambda calibrated against consonance ratings; symbolic pitch-distance model only.
Pitch bins aggregated by exact MIDI (microtonal tolerance); unison pairs not counted.
n_eff is the fully-adjacent pitch count that would yield the same pair sum S.
